title: patch_file failures recorded as tool errors
description: Two patch_file calls failed with 'error applying hunk' during mod.rs modification attempts, recorded as tool errors in RunState. The write was recovered via write_file. The tool-errors rubric criterion will Fail.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file hunk context matching. The relocate logic should handle cases where the file content changed during the run session. Consider a moeb tool that re-reads before patching.

title: Spec path mismatch: fix_signal.skill.md lives in src/ not .moeb/skills/
description: The specification instructs patching .moeb/skills/fix_signal.skill.md but this file does not exist. The binary-bundled skill is at src/moeb/internal/skills/fix_signal.skill.md. The run used the correct src/ path but the spec steps are incorrect.
proposed_resolution: Author a correcting spec that updates the fix_signal.skill.md path references in specifications/moeb/moeb.fix-signal-skill-hardening.md to use src/moeb/internal/skills/fix_signal.skill.md.

title: Missing moeb tool for cargo build and test verification
description: No moeb tool exists to run cargo build --release or cargo test. The agent must use Bash (external tool), causing moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run that includes compilation verification.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb build_and_test tool that runs cargo build and cargo test in the project root, returning exit code and output.

title: Pre-existing test count regression in tool_executor_tests.rs
description: The standard_registry_has_ten_tools test expected 18 tools but standard() had 19 before this run began. The run added 1 more (tag_signal), requiring the count to be updated to 20. The pre-existing off-by-one indicates a prior run added a tool without updating this test.
proposed_resolution: When registering new tools in standard(), the companion test in tool_executor_tests.rs must be updated atomically. Add this requirement to the run.skill.md Implement phase.

title: Rubric score degraded below rolling baseline
description: Current rubric_score (0.80) is more than 10% below the rolling average (0.915) of the last 5 metrics files with scores. Threshold: 0.8235.
proposed_resolution: Revert to the git tag preceding this run, create a diagnostic spec identifying the regression cause, and branch from the pre-regression version.
